predicate.label: spokesperson for
predicate.definition: Person X serves or served as spokesperson for principal Y, which may be a person, organization or public office.
includes: representation through an identified principal office
excludes: communicating to rather than for Y
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: explicit spokesman/spokeswoman/spokesperson; expressly speaking for principal; representation through an identified principal office. Excludes: director/president/adviser/aide/lobbyist/secretary alone; communicating to rather than for Y; forward principal-to-person direction. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: geographic dateline replacing the person; unclear represented principal.

rationale: Secretary and press-corps/spokesman descriptions form the strongest coherent public-speaking role family; known-as names and finance instruments are separate.
